text:
Technique integrates everything. It avoids shock and sensational events. Man is not adapted to a world of steel; technique adapts him to it.

The technique of propaganda is the art of making people act. Propaganda is the art of making people act without thinking.

Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity. Attention, taken to its highest degree, is the same thing as prayer.

Gravity and grace: two forces rule the universe. Grace is the law of the descending movement.
